fields.summary_ko.0: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSM) manufactures, packages, tests, and sells integrated circuits and semiconductor devices in Taiwan, China, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, Japan, and the United States.
fields.summary_ko.1: Serves diverse industry customers in high-performance computing, smartphones, IoT, automotive, and digital consumer electronics, providing various semiconductor process technologies including CMOS, RF, and memory.
